translations.web: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
translations.bsb: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have ruled over us, but Your name alone do we confess.
translations.kjv: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
translations.asv: O Jehovah our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us; but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
